_note: Every sentence on this page is re-run against the UPSTREAM file that produced it, not against this page's own generated data/accountability.json. That is deliberate and it is the same move index/claims.json makes: a page that checks its own derived output only proves the derive script is deterministic, while a page that checks the source proves the sentence is still true. A correction on funding-map/ therefore fails THIS page instead of leaving a flattering number standing here. Paths climb out of accountability/data/ on purpose. The last claim is the staleness guard: it re-runs the derive script's own arithmetic against the shipped accountability.json, so a stale generated file fails loudly rather than rendering yesterday's subtraction.
